titulo: If someone sent you this, they would like to sit in silence with you
alt: A short film for Stories, no voice. A room by a window. Two small block figures with white eyes sit side by side on a bench and say nothing. They blink slowly, then lean toward each other and their eyes turn happy. The text stays on screen: if someone sent you this, they would like to sit in silence with you.
